en.text: The LORD is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? The LORD is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华是我的亮光，是我的拯救， ，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華是我的亮光，是我的拯救， ，

en.text: When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.

zhSimplified.text: 那作恶的就是我的仇敌，

zhTraditional.text: 那作惡的就是我的仇敵，

en.text: Though an army should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear. war should rise against me, even then I will be confident.

zhSimplified.text: 虽有军兵安营攻击我，我的心也不害怕；

zhTraditional.text: 雖有軍兵安營攻擊我，我的心也不害怕；

en.text: One thing I have asked of the LORD, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in the LORD’s house all the days of my life, to see the LORD’s beauty, and to inquire in his temple.

zhSimplified.text: 有一件事，我曾求耶和华，我仍要寻求：

zhTraditional.text: 有一件事，我曾求耶和華，我仍要尋求：

en.text: For in the day of trouble, he will keep me secretly in his pavilion. In the secret place of his tabernacle, he will hide me. He will lift me up on a rock.

zhSimplified.text: 因为我遭遇患难，他必暗暗地保守我；

zhTraditional.text: 因為我遭遇患難，他必暗暗地保守我；

en.text: Now my head will be lifted up above my enemies around me. I will offer sacrifices of joy in his tent. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises to the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 现在我得以昂首，高过四面的仇敌。

zhTraditional.text: 現在我得以昂首，高過四面的仇敵。

en.text: Hear, LORD, when I cry with my voice. Have mercy also on me, and answer me.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，我用声音呼吁的时候，求你垂听；

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，我用聲音呼籲的時候，求你垂聽；

en.text: When you said, “Seek my face,” my heart said to you, “I will seek your face, LORD.”
Don’t hide your face from me. put your servant away in anger. You have been my help. abandon me, neither forsake me, God of my salvation.
When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.
Teach me your way, LORD. Lead me in a straight path, because of my enemies.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，求你将你的道指教我，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，求你將你的道指教我，

en.text: Don’t deliver me over to the desire of my adversaries, for false witnesses have risen up against me, such as breathe out cruelty.

zhSimplified.text: 求你不要把我交给敌人，遂其所愿；

zhTraditional.text: 求你不要把我交給敵人，遂其所願；

en.text: I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.

zhSimplified.text: 我若不信在活人之地得见耶和华的恩惠， 。

zhTraditional.text: 我若不信在活人之地得見耶和華的恩惠， 。

en.text: Wait for the LORD. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. wait for the LORD.
